# E013 -- No18 Brand Identity & Style Guide

## Metadata
- **Company:** No18
- **Industry:** Hospitality (co-working/members club)
- **Year:** 2019
- **Source file:** No18 Brand style guide.pdf
- **Pages:** ~25
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- "The Home For A Rewarding Business Lifestyle" -- brand tagline
- Cosmopolitan members club for businesses: lounges, meeting rooms, high-end workspaces
- "A New Way To Live And Work" -- blend of workplace and residence
- Positioning: premium office, contemporary restaurant, collaborative workspace, vibrant bar
- Promotes everyday wellness and work-life balance
- "A home to our members and a destination to their clients"
- V1.0 -- April 2019, first version of brand guide

## Logo
- Primary logo: always used in 100% black
- Reversed version for black or very dark backgrounds
- Third variant for frosted glass/physical applications
- Reproduced only from master artwork files -- no redrawing/resetting/altering
- Brand tagline lockup available with logo
- Placement rules: centered (default for most marketing), right-aligned (vertical/skyscraper banners), left-aligned (online/browser contexts)
- Correct brand name spelling: "No18" (uppercase N, lowercase o, no punctuation) -- not No.18, #18, or NO18

## Typography
- Gill Sans Std -- primary typeface
- Adobe Garamond Pro -- secondary typeface
- Spaced-out uppercase letterspacing observed in tagline/headlines (characteristic style)

## Color
- Primary and accent color palettes defined (specifics not extracted in sampled pages)

## Graphics
- Iconography system referenced in visual elements overview
- Components system mentioned (section 2.5)

## Photography
- Dedicated photography section (section 3) with four sub-categories:
  - Image types
  - Products and environment
  - Customers
  - Venue photography
- Photography is a significant brand element for this hospitality brand

## Applications
- Skyscraper banners, adverts, posters, leaflets, PowerPoint presentations, website
- Product naming system (section 2.6)
- Layout guidelines (section 2.7)
- Dual branding rules (section 2.8)

## Tone of Voice
- Sophisticated, premium, aspirational
- "Cosmopolitan," "beautifully designed," "high-end" language
- No dedicated TOV section observed but brand manifesto exists (section 1.2)

## Outliers
- Brand name spelling rules are unusually specific (full page dedicated to correct vs incorrect formats)
- Frosted glass logo variant -- shows physical space application focus (hospitality/venue-specific)
- Dual branding section suggests partnerships or multi-venue model
- Three-section structure (Brand, Visual Identity, Photography) is clean and well-organized
- Gill Sans + Garamond pairing: classic British elegance (appropriate for members club positioning)

## Quality Score
- **Score: 3/5** -- Well-organized first-version guide for a hospitality brand. Good coverage of essentials (logo, type, color, photography, applications). Brand name spelling page is a practical touch. Photography section depth is appropriate for venue-based business. Limited in strategic depth and modern digital considerations. Solid foundation for a V1.0.
